name: Marinade Staked SOL

expectedCapabilities.justification: Structurally required. mSOL is minted on SOL deposit and burned on unstake. Without this the token cannot exist.
expectedCapabilities.constrainedBy: The Marinade stake pool program. Mechanical, not discretionary.

evidence.detail: Legacy Token program. decimals 9. mintAuthority ACTIVE, freezeAuthority null, verified against mainnet RPC.
Marinade documents the liquid staking mint and burn mechanism.

caveats: Mint authority being expected does not remove validator, slashing or depeg risk.
This entry speaks only to token structure, never to yield or solvency.
